claims.natural_statement: For fixed integers D>=1 and J>D and d0<1 there is no N->infinity family of two arbitrary C^(J+1) lists, each of size <=N^(d+o(1)), d<=d0, with all derivatives bounded by K=N^o(1), carrying a probability Q with Q_k(i,dt)<=K*pi_ki*dt, sum_i pi_ki=1, value gap <=K/N, and max derivative gap in orders 1..D >=1/K at every event; this remains impossible for all sufficiently small fixed power losses.

The retained nested jet states have support exponent <=d+r(1), and the number of retained level-c descendants in a level-a parent is <=N^(u_c-u_a+o(1)), with atom exponents measured before final selection.

On all but a vanishing fraction of fixed-grid steps, a coarse palette has a fine-to-coarse conditional likelihood bound N^(b^(5/4)), and the unnormalized switching experiment has positive average successful mass.

For each exact start, a single finite measure Lambda on controls dominates all killed full-past adaptive switching kernels by K*N^(b^(5/4))*Lambda(dU)*ds, and backward iteration gives the product bound for necessary tests without conditioning on future survival.

For every positive integer m, factorial-scaled row-reversed power columns weighted by consecutive control differences have determinant equal, up to sign, to the product of those differences times the Vandermonde product, divided by the product of factorials 0! through (m-1)!.

The arbitrary-order endpoint Jacobian, regular-fiber multiplicity, and the common full-past dominating measure imply that successful sampling probability is bounded by the descendant target volume with exponent u_(a+b)-u_a-b*(1/m+(m+1)/2)+(m+1)*b^(5/4)+o(1).

Taking N->infinity on each fixed trimmed grid, then b->0, then removing trims in the endpoint probability estimates forces d>=1; a counterexample diagonal proves a uniform small fixed-power tolerance.

For every natural order and arbitrary real control-difference and switching-coordinate vectors, the endpoint matrix has the factorial-scaled absolute Vandermonde determinant; for every finite hidden-state type, arbitrary full-history nonnegative killed kernels whose displayed fibers are dominated by a common reference weight satisfy the product-reference bound for every length and every nonnegative displayed-path test.

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace TwoColorMatching

noncomputable section

def ascendingJacobian (m : Nat) (g x : Fin m → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ :=
  fun j p => -(g p) * x p ^ j.val / (j.val.factorial : ℝ)

def endpointJacobian (m : Nat) (g x : Fin m → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ :=
  (ascendingJacobian m g x).submatrix Fin.rev id

theorem ascending_det (m : Nat) (g x : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (ascendingJacobian m g x).det =
      (∏ j : Fin m, (j.val.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      (∏ p : Fin m, -(g p)) *
      (∏ i : Fin m, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i)) := by
  let B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun j p => -(g p) * (Matrix.vandermonde x)ᵀ j p
  have h : ascendingJacobian m g x =
      Matrix.of (fun j p => (j.val.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * B j p) := by
    ext j p
    simp [ascendingJacobian, B, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  rw [h, Matrix.det_mul_column]
  dsimp [B]
  rw [Matrix.det_mul_row, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_vandermonde]
  ring

theorem endpoint_abs_det (m : Nat) (g x : Fin m → ℝ) :
    |(endpointJacobian m g x).det| =
      (∏ j : Fin m, (j.val.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      (∏ p : Fin m, |g p|) *
      (∏ i : Fin m, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, |x j - x i|) := by
  have h :
      |(endpointJacobian m g x).det| = |(ascendingJacobian m g x).det| := by
    exact Matrix.abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv
      Fin.revPerm (Equiv.refl (Fin m)) (ascendingJacobian m g x)
  rw [h, ascending_det]
  simp only [abs_mul, Finset.abs_prod, abs_inv, abs_neg, Nat.abs_cast]

variable {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]

def hiddenIntegral (q : List A → A → ℝ≥0) (project : A → B)
    (test : List B → ℝ≥0) : Nat → List A → ℝ≥0
  | 0, h => test (h.map project)
  | n + 1, h => ∑ a : A, q h a * hiddenIntegral q project test n (h ++ [a])

def referenceIntegral (w : B → ℝ≥0) (test : List B → ℝ≥0) :
    Nat → List B → ℝ≥0
  | 0, h => test h
  | n + 1, h => ∑ b : B, w b * referenceIntegral w test n (h ++ [b])

theorem fiber_implies_test (q : A → ℝ≥0) (project : A → B) (w : B → ℝ≥0)
    (hdom : ∀ b, (∑ a : A, if project a = b then q a else 0) ≤ w b)
    (test : B → ℝ≥0) :
    (∑ a : A, q a * test (project a)) ≤ ∑ b : B, w b * test b := by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ a : A, q a * test (project a)) =
        ∑ b : B, (∑ a : A, if project a = b then q a else 0) * test b := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      simp [ite_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ b : B, w b * test b := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => mul_le_mul_right' (hdom b) (test b))

theorem adaptive_domination
    (q : List A → A → ℝ≥0) (project : A → B) (w : B → ℝ≥0)
    (hdom : ∀ h (test : B → ℝ≥0),
      (∑ a : A, q h a * test (project a)) ≤ ∑ b : B, w b * test b)
    (test : List B → ℝ≥0) (n : Nat) (h : List A) :
    hiddenIntegral q project test n h ≤ referenceIntegral w test n (h.map project) := by
  induction n generalizing h with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [hiddenIntegral, referenceIntegral]
      calc
        (∑ a : A, q h a * hiddenIntegral q project test n (h ++ [a])) ≤
            ∑ a : A, q h a * referenceIntegral w test n ((h ++ [a]).map project) := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => mul_le_mul_left' (ih (h ++ [a])) (q h a))
        _ = ∑ a : A, q h a * referenceIntegral w test n (h.map project ++ [project a]) := by
          simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
        _ ≤ ∑ b : B, w b * referenceIntegral w test n (h.map project ++ [b]) :=
          hdom h _

theorem adaptive_domination_from_fibers
    (q : List A → A → ℝ≥0) (project : A → B) (w : B → ℝ≥0)
    (hdom : ∀ h b, (∑ a : A, if project a = b then q h a else 0) ≤ w b)
    (test : List B → ℝ≥0) (n : Nat) (h : List A) :
    hiddenIntegral q project test n h ≤ referenceIntegral w test n (h.map project) := by
  apply adaptive_domination q project w _ test n h
  intro past f
  exact fiber_implies_test (q past) project w (hdom past) f

end

end TwoColorMatching
